originalPrompt:
Granola integration that goes through the Composio TypeScript SDK (@composio/core). Do not call Granola directly. macOS only.

Setup fields: COMPOSIO_API_KEY (secret, required), COMPOSIO_AUTH_CONFIG_ID (required; Composio auth config for the granola_mcp toolkit). Network permission: backend.composio.dev only.

Expose exactly these 7 tools and no others:
- list_recent_meetings: GRANOLA_MCP_LIST_MEETINGS (read)
- get_meeting_notes: GRANOLA_MCP_GET_MEETINGS (read). Input: meeting_ids
- get_transcript: GRANOLA_MCP_GET_MEETING_TRANSCRIPT (read). Input: meeting_id
- search_meetings: GRANOLA_MCP_QUERY_GRANOLA_MEETINGS (read). Input: query
- connect_account: opens the Composio sign-in in the browser
- connection_status: shows whether Granola is connected (read)
- disconnect_account: removes the connection (confirmation card)

This is a starting scaffold that will be rewritten by hand, so keep the code and result cards simple.
